recipes.title: air fry pork spare rib
ingredients: A lot of Mesquite spice (or spice of choice)
steps: Mix all together and marinate 20 min.
Air fry at 360°F for 20 min, flipping halfway.

recipes.title: Baked Ribs BBQ
steps: Season ribs with salt & pepper (can add spice / paprika).
Bake at 275°F for 4 hr, covered with foil.
Make BBQ sauce: sauté onion in olive oil, add cumin, ketchup, hot sauce, and brown sugar; season with salt & pepper and add vinegar if needed.
Add sauce for the last 30 min; broil for the last 10 min.

recipes.title: Chinese Pork Belly
steps: Heat oil.
Fry ginger and shallot.
Fry pork belly till golden.
Add star anise and hua diao wine.
Add soy sauce and fry.
Add wine.
Add rock sugar.
Mix well.
Add water.
Medium-low heat, 1 hr (45 min also ok).
Add scallion on top.
Note: 2 tbsp soy sauce is too salty.

recipes.title: Chinese Steam meat cake
ingredients: 1 large egg or 2 medium (egg white + oil)
steps: Mix meat with salt / chicken powder and soy sauce.
Mix in the preserved mustard (榨菜).
Add egg white.
Pan, steam 3 min on high then 3 min on medium.

recipes.title: Don Por Rou
ingredients: Enough water to cover the pork
steps: Blanch: cold-start the pork with ginger and 2 tbsp Shaoxing wine; once boiling, leave 10 min. Water should submerge the whole pork belly. Cut into cubes after cooking 10 min.
Put scallion / leek on the bottom, pork and everything else on top.
Instant Pot for 1 hr.
After, reduce the liquid and mix after.
Note: no need to add extra water — too much makes it hard to reduce.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Rib
steps: Pat dry after rinsing.
Rub with the dry rub.
Place on the trivet, laid on its side, circled around the pot.
Cover and pressure cook on high: 35 min for spare rib, 23 min for baby back rib. Natural release.
Brush with BBQ sauce and broil 5 min at 425°F.

recipes.title: Pork jowl Airfry
steps: Air fry at 400°F for 11 min.
Note: this failed — came out too crispy, no good. (Try lower / shorter.)

recipes.title: Simple Marinate Porkchop
steps: Smack the pork chop.
Add corn starch water piece by piece, letting it absorb.
Add the rest of the stuff; marinate 4 hr for best.
2 min each side on medium heat.

recipes.title: Steam pork rib
steps: Rinse and soak pork 30 min+.
If possible, for the next 30 min use baking powder: 1 teaspoon mixed with water, soak. If soaked for 30, then soak another 30 in clear water.
Add spice and black bean (bake if needed).
Steam 10 min on high.

recipes.title: Thai Pork Jowl
ingredients: 1 piece pork jowl (or 2-3 pieces pork chop)
steps: Mix all the marinade ingredients.
Marinate the pork jowl (or pork chop).
Grill or pan-fry until cooked through.

recipes.title: Tofu Egg minced pork spicy
ingredients: 1 tbsp spicy bean sauce (豆瓣辣醬)
steps: Mix tofu and eggs by hand; mix in salt and pepper.
Plate and steam for 10 min on high.
Fry the minced meat.
Add ginger, garlic, and spicy bean sauce.
Fry and add soy sauce and oyster sauce.
Add the fried meat on top of the steamed egg / tofu.
